This folder is primarily used by Skeema for determinining a SQL delta to run against our production instance *only*. This folder does not impact GHEX. This folder will only be updated by running our schema tooling (`script/migrate`) against a local database *after* you have applied your migrations to it. You may need to fiddle with the settings in the `.skeema` file to get this script to run locally, we normally only run it in CI.
